I had a very disappointing experience using the McDonald's app.

At around 10:00 PM, I placed a drive-thru pickup order through the app. After arriving at the restaurant, I discovered that the location had actually closed at 8:00 PM for a system update and cleaning. Despite being closed, the app still accepted my order and payment.

What made the experience even more frustrating was that the staff refused to open the door or communicate with me, so I had no way to ask about my order or request assistance. I was left outside with no explanation or solution.

If a restaurant is unavailable due to scheduled maintenance or cleaning, the app should prevent customers from placing orders in the first place. At the very least, staff should communicate with customers who have already placed orders and provide guidance on refunds or alternative solutions.

This experience was frustrating and wasted both my time and money. I hope McDonald's improves the synchronization between the app and restaurant operating status and provides better customer support in situations like this.
